description: This file contains shell script code that sets up, executes, and tests the handling of commit and tag messages with CRLF line endings in a Git environment. It includes functions to create references with CRLF messages, run assertions to verify correct behavior of Git commands with CRLF messages, and conduct various tests related to commit messages, tags, and branch listings.

methods.name: create_crlf_ref
methods.description: Creates a Git reference (branch or tag) with a message containing CRLF line endings, writing the message to a file, creating the reference with git, and tagging it.

methods.name: create_crlf_refs
methods.description: Sets up multiple test references with different CRLF message formats for subsequent testing.

methods.name: test_crlf_subject_body_and_contents
methods.description: Runs tests to verify that Git commands correctly handle commit and tag messages with CRLF line endings, checking formats like --format, --list, --oneline, --log, and --show.
